name: Advanced Data Table Block
author: Ninja

sections.description:
The Advanced Data Table Block block is the ultimate solution for displaying complex data in WordPress. With powerful features and extensive customization options, it’s perfect for any data presentation needs.

🎯 Core Features:

  • Display CSV Data – Easily import CSV files and display data with advanced DataTables functionality
  • Configurable Settings – Complete control over sorting, searching, and pagination from the block settings
  • Responsive Design – Tables look great on both desktop and mobile devices with automatic adaptation
  • Advanced Sorting – Allow users to sort columns in ascending or descending order with visual indicators
  • Powerful Search – Enable search functionality to filter data based on user input in real-time
  • Smart Pagination – Display numeric pagination with customizable page sizes for easier navigation
  • Flexible Dimensions – Set table width and height in percentages or fixed pixel values
  • Sticky Table Headers – Keep header rows fixed while scrolling through large datasets
  • Dynamic Column Sizing – Adjust individual column widths to perfectly suit your data presentation
  • Extensive UI Customization – Complete control over colors, backgrounds, hover effects, and styling
  • Separate Header/Row Styling – Independent customization options for table headers and data rows
  • Multiple Color Schemes – Apply single or multiple color themes to match your site design

📊 Perfect For:
– Product catalogs and comparison tables
– Financial reports and data analytics
– Team directories and contact lists
– Event schedules and timetables
– Inventory and stock management
– Research data presentation
– Survey results and statistics
– Price lists and service offerings

🎨 Styling Options:
– Modern, Striped, Bordered, Minimal, and Card layouts
– Custom color schemes (Blue, Green, Red, Purple, Orange, Gray)
– Individual color controls for headers, rows, borders, and text
– Hover effects and interactive states
– Typography and spacing controls

📱 Mobile Optimized:
– Horizontal scrolling for large tables
– Card-based layout for mobile devices
– Touch-friendly pagination controls
– Responsive search and filter interfaces
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/advanced-data-table-block directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Use the block editor to add the “Advanced Data Table Block ” block to any post or page
  4. Import your CSV data or create tables manually
  5. Customize appearance and functionality in the block settings
  6. Publish and enjoy your professional data tables!
sections.faq:
Can I import data from CSV files?

Yes! The block includes a powerful CSV import feature that allows you to upload CSV files directly in the editor. The data is automatically parsed and formatted into your table.

Is the table responsive on mobile devices?

Absolutely! Tables automatically adapt to smaller screens with horizontal scrolling or switch to a mobile-optimized card layout for better viewing experience.

Can I customize colors and styling?

Yes! The block provides extensive styling options including custom colors for headers, rows, borders, and text. You can also choose from predefined color schemes and table styles.

Does it support sorting and filtering?

Yes! Users can sort any column by clicking the header, and the built-in search functionality filters table content in real-time. All features are configurable from the block settings.

Can I control the table dimensions?

Yes! You can set both width and height using percentages or fixed pixel values. The sticky header feature keeps headers visible when scrolling through tall tables.

Is pagination supported?

Yes! The block includes smart pagination with configurable page sizes (10, 25, 50, 100+ rows per page) and numeric navigation controls.
